_comment: Hand-written fixes folded into Data.lua by build_db.py / update_db.py. Keys are item IDs. Set a field to a value or null (removes it); 'src+' adds sources, 'src-' removes sources matching the given keys; '_delete': true drops the item. Source types: drop, quest, vendor, craft. A source may name its creature by Questie ID ("npc": 263380): name, zone and map location then come from Questie. Example: "12345": { "rl": 20, "src+": [ { "t": "quest", "n": "Quest name", "z": "Zone" } ] }
_hide_sources_comment: Every item with a source of one of these names is left out of the database and hidden in game.
